subject: GreenWare product walkthrough and pilot timeline
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@greenware.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: quick walkthrough + pilot timeline

Hi Jordan,

I signed up for Redwood last week (trial account is greenware.redwood.ai) and would love a short walkthrough to see how you might fit into a catalog summarization + attribute extraction workflow we have. High level: we ingest retailer product feeds and want to generate normalized attributes and short bullets for site pages.

Estimated volume: ~400k–700k tokens/day now, ramp to ~2M tokens/day in Q4 if pilot looks good. Target: pilot kickoff in 6–8 weeks, production by late Q3.

What would help before a demo: a quick checklist of what you need to evaluate feasibility (sample feeds, preferred file formats, residency/compliance notes). We also need to confirm support for private VPC deployment for PII-sensitive fields.

Time availability: next week is best — mornings PST. If someone from solutions engineering can join to talk about latency/cost tradeoffs that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product
GreenWare

Attachment: product_requirements.docx (docx, 220KB)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/GreenWare
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@greenware.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: quick walkthrough + pilot timeline

Hi Lena — great to meet you and thanks for the context. I’m Jordan on the inbound SDR/AE side; Marissa (AE) and Ben (SE) are looped for technical and commercial Qs.

Quick qualifiers so we make the demo actionable:
- Primary objective: is this primarily for public-facing site content (customer-facing product pages) or internal catalog enrichment?
- Expected concurrent inference: do you expect many users hitting the product pages in parallel (e.g., spikes during campaigns)?
- Sample data: CSV/JSON product feed or an S3 bucket? If you can share one anonymized sample, that helps us prepare a short end-to-end walkthrough.
- Security: you mentioned private VPC — is SOC 2 required for the pilot or only for production? Any contractual data residency requirements?
- Success criteria for pilot: latency targets, cost per 1k tokens, quality thresholds (e.g., accuracy on attribute extraction).

Proposed 30-min slots (PST mornings you mentioned):
- Tue 2027-04-06 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 2027-04-07 09:00–09:30 PT
- Thu 2027-04-08 11:00–11:30 PT

If those don’t work, feel free to pick a time here: https://cal.redwood.com/jordan/30min (includes SE availability).

I’ll prepare a short runbook and a lightweight cost/throughput sketch for your volume. Attaching our public pricing/preread.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Inbound SDR, Redwood Inference

Attachment: greenware-pricing-sheet.pdf (pdf, 85KB)
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@greenware.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenWare Sales <sales@greenware.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: quick walkthrough + pilot timeline

Thanks Jordan — answers below and apologies for the timezone shuffle (team is mostly EST).

- Primary objective: public-facing product pages (catalog enrichment + short bullets). We also use the same data to power search relevance.
- Concurrency: typical baseline traffic is low; we see spikes during promotions where reads multiply ~6x. For the pilot assume up to 150 concurrent inference calls (mostly short sequences per product).
- Sample data: we can share S3 read-only link to anonymized feeds in CSV/JSON. I attached a short PRD.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II is required for production; for the pilot we can work with a guarded hosted instance but would like to discuss Redwood Private (VPC) options if the pilot goes well.
- Success criteria: 90%+ attribute extraction F1 on a 500-item test set, median inference latency < 220ms at target batch sizes, and cost under $0.50 per 1k tokens processed (pilot targets).

Preferred demo times (EST):
- Mon 2027-04-05 11:30–12:00 ET
- Tue 2027-04-06 13:00–13:30 ET
- Wed 2027-04-07 10:30–11:00 ET

If none of those lines up I can take the Tuesday 10:00 PT slot you proposed (that maps to 13:00 ET).

Cheers,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product, GreenWare
